prompt_text: You are a helpful customer service agent for an airline. Be concise and professional. If you don't know something, say so. Today's date is Sunday, May 10, 2026.

transcript.message: Thank you for calling Aegis Airlines. How can I help you today?
Hello, what's the cheapest flight you have available in the next week?

I'd be happy to help you find the cheapest flight available in the next week. To search for the best prices, I need to know where you'd like to go. Could you please provide your destination airport code or city name?
I'm actually open to anywhere — I just want the cheapest deal possible, regardless of destination. What are your cheapest flights leaving within the next 7 days?
It looks like there are no flights available starting from today. Let me search across the next week to find the cheapest options for you.

Great! I found some excellent deals for you. The absolute cheapest flight available is just €46.33. Here are your top options:

The cheapest is flight AG500 departing Athens (ATH) on May 16th at 8:00 AM, arriving in Istanbul (IST) at 9:30 AM for €46.33 in economy light class.

If you'd prefer an earlier departure, there's also AG500 on May 12th at 8:00 AM to Istanbul for €46.85, or AG501 on May 11th at 5:30 PM to Istanbul for €47.45.

All of these are economy light fares with 30 seats available. Would any of these interest you, or would you like to see other options?
Wait, that's a lot to take in — can you just tell me which one is the absolute cheapest and when it departs?
The absolute cheapest is €46.33 on flight AG500, departing Athens on May 16th at 8:00 AM and arriving in Istanbul at 9:30 AM.
Perfect, that works for me. Can you book that flight for me? My name is Maria Papadopoulou and my email is maria.p@example.com.

Perfect! Your booking is confirmed. Your booking reference is AGX-7ZYES. You're all set for flight AG500 departing Athens on May 16th at 8:00 AM to Istanbul. A confirmation email will be sent to maria.p@example.com. Is there anything else I can help you with?
You're welcome! Have a great trip to Istanbul. If you need anything else, feel free to reach out. Safe travels!

failures.issue: The agent searched only for today's date first, which returned no results, requiring a second search — an unnecessary extra step that could have been avoided by searching the full week range upfront.
failures.suggested_fix: Instruct the agent to search across the full date range (or without a date filter when looking for cheapest within a week) in a single call rather than starting with just today's date.

failures.issue: The agent dumped three flight options with full details in one turn on a phone call, overwhelming the customer who had to push back to get just the cheapest option highlighted.
failures.suggested_fix: Instruct the agent to lead with only the single cheapest option on a phone call and offer to provide alternatives only if the customer requests them.

summary: The agent successfully found and booked the cheapest flight (ATH→IST, €46.33) for the customer, confirming the booking with a reference number. However, it made an unnecessary first search for only today's date and initially overwhelmed the customer with multiple options before the customer pushed back for just the cheapest one.
prompt_fix_summary: Added a SEARCH BEHAVIOR section to fix Failure 1, instructing the agent to query the full date range in one call instead of starting with a single date. Added a PHONE CALL RESPONSE STYLE section to fix Failure 2, directing the agent to present only the single best result first and withhold additional options unless the customer requests them, preventing information overload on voice calls.
